name: Elextra Widgets for Elementor
author: Robert Biswas

sections.description:
Elextra Widgets for Elementor is a growing collection of creative and useful Elementor widgets designed to help developers and designers build modern websites faster and easier — especially those creating Envato Template Kits.

The plugin starts with two essential widgets, built to enhance your design flexibility and interactivity:

  1. Marquee Text Widget – Create smooth, continuous scrolling text sections to highlight announcements, headlines, or taglines with style.
  2. Logo Carousel Widget – Display client logos, partner brands, or sponsors in an elegant, responsive carousel layout.
  3. Infinite Rotation Setting – After apply this setting the widget will start rotating such as an image but it works on most kind of widgets.
  4. Masked Image – You can mask image as you provide a png image.
  5. Hover List
  6. Accordion
  7. Hover List Image

These widgets are lightweight, easy to use, and fully customizable directly within the Elementor editor — no coding required.

Our mission is to expand Elextra Widgets for Elementor with more powerful widgets in future updates, helping you save time and bring your design ideas to life effortlessly.

Features

  • Seamless integration with Elementor Page Builder
  • Lightweight & optimized for performance
  • Responsive design for all screen sizes
  • Easy customization through the Elementor interface
  • Future-ready — new widgets coming soon
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/elextra-widgets-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Start using the new widgets under the Elextra Widgets section in the Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

No, Elextra Widgets for Elementor works with the free version of Elementor.

Will you add more widgets?

Yes! We’re actively developing more widgets and will release them in future updates.
